title: Bride and Groom Cutting Wedding Cake, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photograph
description: A classic post-WWII era black and white snapshot showing a young bride and groom standing beside their multi-tiered wedding cake featuring a heart-shaped cake topper. The groom is dressed in a double-breasted suit with wide lapels and a boutonniere, while the bride wears a satin outfit with a prominent white floral corsage.
